narrow_orbit_room.name: Narrow Orbit Story Room

agents.claim: The lamp-and-cord incident turns mutual irritation into one visible consequence and an equal repair.
agents.objection: The familiar bad-day premise would remain generic without a specific shared incident.
agents.recommendation: Use the cramped room, extension board, tipping lamp, blackout, and joint relighting as the causal spine.

agents.claim: Both partners care, obstruct, escalate, and repair; neither becomes handler or problem.
agents.objection: A one-sided rescue would weaken the copy's mutual truth.
agents.recommendation: Keep the repair mechanically complementary and emotionally restrained.

narrow_orbit_room.summary: The route passes because one lived domestic incident proves residual care, reciprocal escalation, equal repair, and a quiet continued choosing.
inputs_used: selected Aachu and Zuv identity bundle
debate_records: A generic argument montage was rejected in favor of one causal room event.
A mirror self-jab was rejected in favor of a bodily hair-tie action.
A hug payoff was rejected in favor of shared light and the last piece of food.

selected_outputs.hero_receipt: opposite plug pulls tip the shared lamp
selected_outputs.payoff: the couple finishes the meal inside the restored light

exploration_routes.name: Narrow Orbit
exploration_routes.story_lens: Anti-Ideal To Real Love through one causal lived incident
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Two loving people can genuinely dislike each other for one evening without that evening defining the relationship.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: Both arrive frayed and make the same tiny room harder for each other.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's own tension appears in the hair tie before her separate task collides with Zuv's.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv protects her glass, creates half the plug collision, supports the lamp base during repair, and receives the final piece of food.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Slack cord becomes taut, the shared lamp tips and goes dark, then two complementary hands restore it.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The same people whose uncoordinated actions darken the room restore the light together without pretending the anger vanished.
exploration_routes.payoff: The room remains imperfect, but the nearly finished meal and final exchange prove the day was not the whole relationship.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: It gives couples precise language and a sendable image for the familiar truth that love can outlast an ugly mood.

stage_scene_gate.action: Aachu and Zuv pull separate plug ends from opposite sides.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: The board slides, the intact lamp tips, and both recoil.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: They avoid one another until their eyes meet only when the warm light returns.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: The slack cord becomes taut; Zuv later supports the lamp while Aachu reconnects its plug.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The cool blackout holds their anger honestly before either begins repair.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The room darkens because both pulled without coordinating.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The light returns only through equal coordinated action.

selected_story_lens: Anti-Ideal To Real Love through one causal lived incident
emotional_machine: two bad moods enter one small room -> reciprocal care survives irritation -> both create a visible consequence -> anger remains honest while both repair together -> one evening cannot define the relationship
proof_engine: A slack shared cord becomes taut and tips the lamp; two complementary actions make the light return.
reader_mirror: We have both had a day when love remained true even though neither of us was pleasant to live with.
distribution_reason: The precise bad-mood recognition and non-sentimental repair make the carousel sendable to a partner.

human_story_setup.cold_reader_doorway: I loved you; I just did not like your face that day.
human_story_setup.emotional_obstacle: Both arrive frayed and make the same tiny room harder for each other.
human_story_setup.visible_human_proof: They protect each other's things, obstruct each other, tip and unplug the lamp together, then restore it with equal action.
human_story_setup.relationship_motion: Both initiate care, both cause escalation, and both perform the repair.
human_story_setup.emotional_turn: The first changed fact is coordinated action, not sweetness.
human_story_setup.shareable_setup: A cold viewer recognizes the ugly mood that never became the whole relationship.
human_story_setup.earned_payoff: A bad day was never the whole truth about us.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer recognizes a familiar mutual bad mood before admiring the art and wants to send the payoff to a partner.
success_definition.creative_success: The lamp incident reads causally with no copy visible, and anger and love remain simultaneously observable.
success_definition.brand_success: The deck turns one awkward domestic behavior into warm, non-shaming relationship recognition for @a.storyof.two.
success_definition.production_success: Copy, identity references, the 1080x1440 canvas, copy-hidden story proof, exact text, brandmark, visual QA, and final audit all pass.
success_definition.memory_excerpt: Recognition first; concrete couple receipt; reciprocal relationship motion; earned sendable thesis.

stage_scene_gate.consequence: The room darkens because both pulled; the warm practical light returns only through equal coordinated action.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The same cord that divided them becomes slack inside one shared pool of light.
